cases.q: When and where can I meet Powerline Max in December?
cases.answer: Disney lists Max Goof as Powerline at Disney Jollywood Nights (Hollywood Studios), at the Echo Lake Holiday Celebration. December party nights: Dec 5, 7, 12, 14, 19, 21 and 23, 7:30 PM to 12:30 AM. Disney doesn't post a meet time for it, and the party needs its own ticket.

cases.answer: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party (Magic Kingdom) has 13 nights in December: Dec 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, 18, 20 and 22. It runs 7 PM to midnight, with entry from 4 PM.

cases.q: Is Jollywood Nights worth it?
cases.answer: Disney Jollywood Nights (Hollywood Studios): 15 nights coming up (Nov 7, 14, 16, 21, 23, 28; Dec 5, 7…), 7:30 PM to 12:30 AM, tickets $169 to $199 plus tax.
